# Abnormally High Traffic at S-TUN-002 Due to Stadium Event

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-002`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced by external event EVT-004, anomaly detection ALR-0040, and KPI deviations matching the exact timing and geographic scope. Maintenance and topology were checked, but the change log was NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-28 19:00 to 2026-09-28 22:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-28 18:56
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, CORE-UPF-01

## Summary

Traffic surge at S-TUN-002 was caused by an external stadium event (Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades) driving up active users and resource utilization.

Active users, download volume, PRB utilization, and latency spiked at S-TUN-002 between 2026-09-28 19:00 and 2026-09-28 22:30 before fully recovering.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-28 18:56: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades begins (EVT-004). [EVT-004]
- 2026-09-28 19:00: Earliest KPI onset observed: S-TUN-002 active_users above baseline (T4). [T4]
- 2026-09-28 19:15: Anomaly alert ALR-0040 starts, showing spikes in traffic, active users, latency, and PRB utilisation at S-TUN-002 (T1). [T1, ALR-0040]
- 2026-09-28 22:30: Impact recovery: KPIs return to baseline and alert ALR-0040 ends (T1, T4). [T1, T4, ALR-0040]
- 2026-09-28 22:37: Concert at Stade Olympique de Rades ends (EVT-004). [EVT-004]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-002 experienced a medium severity anomaly alert (ALR-0040) involving traffic, active users, latency, PRB utilisation, and UPF throughput spikes. [T1, ALR-0040]
- A concert event took place at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-004) from 2026-09-28 18:56 to 2026-09-28 22:37. [T3, EVT-004]
- S-TUN-002 active users, download volume, PRB utilization, and latency deviated significantly above baseline starting at 19:00 and recovering at 22:30. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-002 or its parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-002: confirmed. The timing, duration, and geographic footprint of the concert event (EVT-004) align perfectly with the traffic and user spikes observed at S-TUN-002. [T1, T3, T4, EVT-004]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-TUN-01-B: rejected. No equipment failure or transport issues were reported, and KPIs recovered cleanly after the stadium event concluded. [T2, T4]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance was scheduled on S-TUN-002 or its ancestors during the relevant time window, ruling out planned maintenance as a cause.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor similar venue-adjacent sites during large public gatherings for predictable capacity surges.
